Lemma
[interaction with the identity curvature operator] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0126, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0127 ↗ def:chow-ii-sharp-product ↗ def:chow-ii-algebraic-ricci-contraction 1. ch11:11.33\group Curvature Operator Algebra For $R\in \mathcal A_n$, \[ R+R\# I=\operatorname {Rc}(R)\wedge \operatorname {id} =(n-1)R_I+\frac{n-2}{2}R_{\operatorname {Rc}_0}. \]
Proof

\sketch In an orthonormal basis, the intrinsic sharp formula gives

\[ (R\# I)_{abcd}=\frac12(r_{ac}\delta _{bd}-r_{ad}\delta _{bc} +r_{bd}\delta _{ac}-r_{bc}\delta _{ad})-R_{abcd}, \]

where $r=\operatorname {Rc}(R)$; the Bianchi identity is used to collect the four contraction terms. The first equality follows from the component formula for $r\wedge \operatorname {id}$. The second follows by applying the decomposition of 3.

□
